import sys

mod = 998244353

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = int(input_data[0])
    m = int(input_data[1])
    p = int(input_data[2])
    q = int(input_data[3])
    x = q - p + 1
    if p % 2 == 0:
        x = x - x // 2
    else:
        x //= 2
    y = q - p + 1 - x

    dp = [dict(), dict()]

    def fn(x, y, st, type_):
        if st in dp[type_]:
            return dp[type_][st]
        if st == 1:
            if type_ == 0:
                return x
            else:
                return y
        if st % 2 == 1:
            res = (x * fn(x, y, st - 1, type_) + y * fn(x, y, st - 1, (type_ + 1) % 2)) % mod
            dp[type_][st] = res
            return res
        else:
            nch = fn(x, y, st // 2, 1)
            ch = fn(x, y, st // 2, 0)
            if type_ == 0:
                ans = (ch * ch + nch * nch) % mod
            else:
                ans = (2 * ch * nch) % mod
            dp[type_][st] = ans
            return ans

    def bin_pow(x, st):
        if st == 0:
            return 1
        if st == 1:
            return x
        m = st // 2
        ans = bin_pow(x, m)
        if st % 2 == 0:
            return (ans * ans) % mod
        else:
            return ((ans * ans) % mod * x) % mod

    if ((n & m) % 2) == 0:
        ans = fn(x, y, n * m, 0)
        print(ans)
    else:
        ans = bin_pow(x + y, n * m)
        print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
